localFacts.fact: Destatis: Männer in Deutschland sind im Schnitt 1,79 m groß, Frauen 1,66 m. Replaces the CDC US averages (68.9 in / 63.5 in) in the eye-level section.

Lufthansa allows carry-on bags of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm. For location headshots by plane: the Befree GT XPRO (43 cm), the Feisol and the MT190XPRO4 (49 cm each) and the 055 (54 cm) fold shorter than 55 cm; the Vanguard VEO 3+ kit (77 cm) does not.
Feisol Europe gives the CT-3442 Rapid 140 cm working height without column and 174 cm with the optional carbon column kit (1,14 kg legs only, 1,33 kg with column in the spec table).

German terms: Kugelkopf (ball head), Stativkopf, Mittelsäule (centre column), Arbeitshöhe (working height), Schnellwechselplatte; Bewerbungsfoto / Business-Porträt are the common words for a headshot; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Photographers want a tripod tall enough to look through the viewfinder without bending, ideally without raising the column.
localPainPoints.fix: Legs-only height decides it: Vanguard 148 cm, Befree 142 cm, Feisol and 055 140 cm put the viewfinder near standing eye level for an average German (post: lens-height section and the 'bad posture' pain point).

quotes.text: Im Idealfall so hoch das ich mich ohne krumm zu machen durch den Sucher schauen kann (selber bin ich 178cm).

localPainPoints.pain: Forum users say a centre column is fine as long as it stays down, and warn against long, wobbly column constructions.
localPainPoints.fix: Set the legs for the typical client and use the column only for the last centimetres between people (post: tldr point 4 and how-to step 5).

quotes.text: Es gibt auch sehr gute Stative mit Mittelsäule (am besten sind sie natürlich wenn sie unten bleibt).
Auf lange, windige Mittelsäulenkonstruktionen würde ich jedenfalls verzichten.

localGain.point: Eye-level targets for German averages (Destatis), with 17 cm head and camera on top: average man 1,79 m -> eye level about 166 to 169 cm -> legs of about 149 to 152 cm; only the Vanguard (148 cm) comes within a few cm on its legs. Average woman 1,66 m -> eye level about 153 to 156 cm -> legs of about 136 to 139 cm; Feisol, 055, Befree and Vanguard clear it, the MT190XPRO4 (135 cm) is a few cm short.
Location headshots by plane: Lufthansa's 55 cm cabin-bag length takes the Befree (43 cm), Feisol and MT190XPRO4 (49 cm) and 055 (54 cm), not the Vanguard kit (77 cm).
Maker metric figures instead of conversions, including Vanguard Europe's 148 cm / 174 cm / 77 cm for the VEO 3+ kit and Feisol Europe's 140 cm / 174 cm for the CT-3442.
